transcript.text: Hi everyone. Before I sign the Northstar Analytics earn-out settlement, I need to flag a few concerns with the current draft. First, it recommends paying the full $4.8 million claim at closing with no escrow — given the size of this claim, I'd want to understand the basis for waiving any escrow protection. Second, the draft doesn't specify a tax-remittance timetable, which we need resolved. Under our standard closing checklist, I'm asking legal and tax to review this settlement immediately before I sign. Can we get that review underway so I'm not the bottleneck on closing?

transcript.text: While reviewing the indemnity schedule this week, I confirmed that an unresolved environmental claim entitles the company to retain exactly $1,200,000 of the earn-out in escrow for 90 days after closing. I recorded this in a working note that hasn't been circulated yet. This directly addresses Mara's concern about waiving escrow protection — we can't pay the full $4.8 million at closing with no escrow. We need to revise the settlement to hold back $1.2 million for 90 days post-closing, which would mean releasing $3.6 million at closing.
